cues: For a plant cell, two parts matter.
Psi s, the solute potential, is zero or negative, because dissolved solutes lower it.
Psi p, the pressure potential, is positive when the wall pushes back on a swollen cell, and, remember this, negative in the xylem, where water is under tension.
